name: Elephant
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Proficiency bonus +2. Passive Perception 10. No listed skill proficiencies, special senses or languages.
appearance: A massive grey elephant with broad ears, long ivory tusks and a trunk that curls at the tip.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0 (2018), Chapter 12, p. 125.
sections.Traits: Trampling Charge. Move at least 20 ft. in a straight line toward a creature and hit it with Gore on the same turn. The target makes a DC 12 Strength save and falls prone on a failure. The elephant may make one Stomp against that target as a bonus action if it is prone.
sections.Actions:
Gore. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit against one target within 5 ft. On a hit, deal 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage.
Stomp. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit against one prone creature within 5 ft. On a hit, deal 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
sections.At the table: Stomp can be used as an action against a prone creature. Trampling Charge also permits the bonus-action use described in the trait.
sections.Printing note: The 2018 uses +5 in both damage formulas. Its current D&D Beyond counterpart displays the corrected Monster Manual damage. This entry follows the scoped .

name: Owl
otherStatistics: Proficiency bonus +2. Perception +3, Stealth +3. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 13. No listed languages.
appearance: A small barn owl with a pale, heart-shaped facial disk, dark eyes, tawny wings and curved talons.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0 (2018), Chapter 12, p. 147.
sections.Traits:
Flyby. Flying out of an enemy’s reach does not provoke that enemy’s opportunity attack.
Keen Hearing and Sight. Roll Wisdom (Perception) checks with advantage when they rely on hearing or sight.
sections.Actions: Talons. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit against one target within 5 ft. On a hit, deal 1 slashing damage.
sections.At the table: Apply Keen Hearing and Sight to the relevant checks. When using passive Perception with that advantage, the effective value is 18.

name: Weasel
otherStatistics: Proficiency bonus +2. Perception +3, Stealth +5. Passive Perception 13. No listed special senses or languages.

sections.Traits: Keen Hearing and Smell. Roll Wisdom (Perception) checks with advantage when they rely on hearing or smell.
